source: Derived from EN product meanings and existing hu/auth tone (informal te). SK used only for product sense. Not human-approved.

addressStyle.rationale: Existing hu/auth already uses informal forms (e.g. « Már a nyelveden van. »). Aligned with CS/SK/DE informal social-app tone. PROPOSED — not product-approved.

antiPatterns: Do not translate word-by-word from EN; keep natural Hungarian word order
Avoid case endings directly on {placeholders} (values are inserted in the nominative; vowel harmony cannot be applied at runtime) — use constructions such as « ...: {name} »
Do not use charity « adomány » for token top-ups
Write Hungarian compounds as one word (Fiókbeállítások, Alkalmazásbeállítások) — not as two separate words

terms.notes: User content unit — not the same as Contribution (Hozzájárulás).
Loanword « feed » kept pending decision; inflected as « feedhez », « feededből ».
English role label kept; plural « donorok ».
English role label kept; plural written « donee-k » (hyphenated suffix).
Act of help — do not confuse with Bejegyzés (Post).
Avoid charity « adományozás » for token top-ups.
Singular after numerals: « 5 token »; plural « tokenek ».

pluralization.note: Hungarian uses singular after numerals; EN pipe count is preserved (2-form: « {n} napja | {n} napja », 3-form feed.resultsCount: zero|one|other). No custom pluralRules registered in boot/i18n.ts; default vue-i18n rule verified at runtime for n=0,1,2,5,21.

notes: Token capitalization (Token/Tokenek in FAQ/explainer vs token/tokenek in UI) is inconsistent — pending human review.
